How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GeM Manager/Senior Manager – Analytics recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Manager/Senior Manager – Analytics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: A Graduate degree in Engineering, technology, or a related discipline is required. A Post-graduate degree is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is in the E3/E4 pay scale.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: You need to apply via email by sending your complete application with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of GeM?
faq.answer: The official website of GeM is gem.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is New Delhi, Delhi.
